# Arena

> > Crowdsourced AI model evaluation platform using human preference battles and Elo ratings to benchmark LLMs and vision models.

Arena is developed by researchers at UC Berkeley and uses the Bradley-Terry system to rank AI models through real-world human feedback. The platform includes Chatbot Arena, Vision Arena, and open research datasets like LMSYS-Chat-1M used in leading ML conferences (ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR).

## Key Topics

- Chatbot Arena
- Elo rating system
- Bradley-Terry model
- Human preference evaluation
- Crowdsourced benchmarking
- LLM-as-a-judge
- Arena-Hard
- Vision Arena
- LMSYS-Chat-1M dataset
- Prompt-to-Leaderboard
- RouteLLM
- Battle mode voting
- Model ranking leaderboards
- Open research transparency
